summary: Module 06 CONTEXT: identified parallel vs serial tickets and named interface contracts for SkillSwap-style A/B/C/D set. Constraints twist from Module 05 carried forward (prescriptive tickets + standards cite).
evidence: Q1 Parallel now: Ticket A (availability API) + Ticket C (provider profile frontend) — different layers; contract = provider profile JSON (id UUID, display_name, services[], ratings summary).
Also parallel once contract exists: Ticket B (booking API) + Ticket D (email) if they agree on booking_created event shape (booking_id, learner_id, provider_id, starts_at).
Q2 Cannot parallel: A and B — B consumes open slots from A; booking without availability API has nothing to book.
Q3 Contract A↔C: GET provider shape with UUID ids. Contract B↔D: booking_created payload fields listed above. user_id/learner_id = UUID everywhere (Module 05 lesson).
